Scene:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国：delete一天；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜：wrong information, it’s not his mother’s job
- 孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家：delete因为

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 很多墓地得我祭拜：我得去很多墓地祭拜，The modal verb requires the person who must act as its subject; the place phrase belongs with the action of going there. [rule: none]
Run 2: 他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。：他妈妈说：“从早到晚，我得去很多墓地祭拜。”，Direct speech needs a colon and quotation marks. Also, the person who has an obligation must be the subject of the modal verb “得”: “我得 + verb phrase,” not “很多墓地得我祭拜.” [rule: none]
Run 3: (nothing flagged here)

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 address the modal-verb word order, but Run 2 also changes direct-speech punctuation and Run 3 provides no correction.
